experiments.scope: Linearization technique demonstration for 11-round Poseidon (r=3 partial rounds) over Pallas field. The experiment finds a linearizing line where state[2] after round 0 becomes constant (zero), reducing the effective polynomial degree from 5^11 to approximately 5^8. It loads actual Orchard/Pallas constants, computes the fifth root in the Pallas field, verifies the linearization property, and evaluates Poseidon at 256 points along the linearizing line. This validates the algebraic structure exploitation technique but does not perform a full collision search. Observations: linearizing_line_found, state2_constant_verified, evaluations_performed, elapsed_seconds.
